fields.note: Al + acrylic overcoat (Sheldahl film product, A 0.14, eps 0.05), TARC (a roof coating, cold state A ~0.25, sky-window eps 0.20) and the switchable eps 0.05 night state (050) are transfers to a Be skin. Installed mass, adhesion, UV and humidity life and wet optics are unknown; areal mass was held at MLCCAg's 8.33 g/m2. 048's legacy finish screen (037 day SF >= 1.678, full-cycle >= 1) was not evaluated. The static Al+AOC skin reaches 319 K by day at ISA. A switchable state must switch by skin temperature, not by sun: in its day state the edge is 269.7 K without sun credit.
